info.name: Cab Booking Platform API
info.description: Generated from backend/src/docs/routes.ts (run `npm run postman`). Login flow: OTP request -> OTP verify (stores tokens).

item.name: Customers
GET /customers/me/places - List own saved places (home, work, other)
POST /customers/me/places - Create a saved place (enforces configurable limit, valid coordinates)
PATCH /customers/me/places/{placeId} - Update own saved place
DELETE /customers/me/places/{placeId} - Delete own saved place
GET /customers/me/referrals - Get unique referral code, shareable link, referral stats and reward history
POST /customers/me/referrals/claim - Apply a referral code to receive referral coupon reward
GET /customers/me - Get own profile
PATCH /customers/me - Update own profile
Admin
POST /admin/customers/{customerId}/restrictions - Apply or lift a booking restriction on a customer (mandatory reason, audited)
GET /admin/drivers - Search/filter drivers
GET /admin/drivers/{driverId} - Driver detail (audited; includes document download URLs)
PATCH /admin/drivers/{driverId}/approval - APPROVE | REJECT | REQUEST_RESUBMISSION | SUSPEND (reason required except APPROVE)
PATCH /admin/drivers/{driverId}/documents/{documentId} - Approve or reject a document
PATCH /admin/vehicles/{vehicleId}/verification - Verify or reject a vehicle
GET /admin/audit-logs - Search audit log
GET /admin/dashboard - Ops counters: active bookings, last 24 h by status, drivers online, review queues
GET /admin/users - Search users by role, account status, phone or name
GET /admin/users/{userId} - User detail (role, status, live sessions, driver/booking summary)
PATCH /admin/users/{userId}/status - Suspend or reactivate a customer (suspending ends all sessions). Staff accounts need SUPER_ADMIN; drivers use the approval decision
GET /admin/bookings - Search bookings by status, payment status, customer, driver, id prefix, date range
GET /admin/bookings/{bookingId} - Full booking: fare snapshot, ride, event timeline, dispatch offers (audited)
GET /admin/rides/{rideId}/trail - The sampled route the driver took during the ride (disputes and support). Location data, so every read is audited. Points are kept 30 days
POST /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/fee/waive - Waive a cancellation or no-show fee (audited; the rider is told)
GET /admin/documents/expiring - Driver documents expiring within N days (default 30) plus those already expired
Notifications
POST /admin/notifications/test - Send an audited test push or SMS notification to a specific eligible recipient

POST /devices - Register this phone for push. The push token belongs to one user: registering it on another account moves it. Call again whenever the token changes; send deviceId so the old token is replaced
DELETE /devices/{deviceId} - Stop push to this device (call on logout). Only your own devices
GET /notifications - In-app inbox, newest first. meta.unreadCount is the badge number
POST /notifications/read - Mark notifications read: send { ids: [...] } or { all: true }
Operations
GET /admin/drivers/live - Live map feed of online and on-ride drivers within bounding box or zone (audited)

POST /admin/system/test-alert - Sends a harmless TEST ALERT through the real alert path (the log and, if ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL is set, the Slack/Discord webhook). Answers webhookConfigured and delivered (true only if the webhook accepted it). Use it after setting the webhook, and after any change to it. Audited

GET /admin/system/health - What the monitor sees right now: ledger balanced, stuck searches, unanswered SOS, push backlog, unfinished webhooks, payments missing from the ledger, dead background jobs. Each check says OK or what to do
GET /admin/system/metrics - Request counts and speed per route (average and 95th percentile), status classes, server errors in the last 5 minutes, memory and event-loop lag for this server
GET /metrics - The same numbers as Prometheus text for a metrics tool. Not a staff login: send Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>. Returns 404 when no token is configured
Dispatch
GET /admin/dispatch/queue - List bookings awaiting driver assignment with server-calculated waiting duration
POST /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/assign-driver - Manually assign or reassign an eligible driver to a booking with atomic conditional claim (audited)
GET /drivers/me/offers - Live (unexpired) ride offers for this driver

exec: const o = pm.response.json().data[0]; if (o) pm.collectionVariables.set('offerId', o.offerId);

item.name: POST /ride-offers/{offerId}/accept - Accept an offer. Atomic: exactly one driver wins; others get 409 RIDE_ALREADY_ASSIGNED / OFFER_UNAVAILABLE. Retrying your own accept returns the same ride.
POST /ride-offers/{offerId}/reject - Decline an offer; dispatch moves on to the next driver
POST /bookings/{bookingId}/dispatch/retry - Search again for a booking in NO_DRIVER_FOUND (fresh round)
Locations

POST /locations/autocomplete - Address suggestions while the rider or driver types. Send the same sessionToken (any 8-64 character id the app makes) for every keystroke of one search and for the place lookup that follows, so the search is billed once. near (the position of the user) puts close places first. Each suggestion has a placeId; send it to POST /locations/place to get coordinates. Limited per user per minute

POST /locations/place - The coordinates and address of a suggestion the user picked (from POST /locations/autocomplete). 404 if the place is unknown. Use the returned point as the pickup or drop of a fare quote
POST /locations/reverse-geocode - Names a spot on the map (the pin the user dropped). address is null when nothing is known there

POST /routes/estimate - A route preview: road distance, time and the path (polyline in Google encoded format, null if unavailable). For drawing the trip on a map only. The price of a trip always comes from POST /fare-quotes, never from here
Files

PUT /files/upload - Send a file to the signed link returned by POST /drivers/me/documents (server upload folder). Send the file bytes as the body with the same Content-Type that was declared. The link works for 10 minutes; the file must be a real JPEG, PNG or PDF within the size limit. No login token is needed: the link is the permission

GET /files/download - Download a file through a signed link (for example the one staff get when they open a driver document). The link works for 5 minutes. The file is always sent as a download, never shown as a page
Payments

POST /rides/{rideId}/cash-collection/customer-confirm - The rider says how much cash they handed to the driver (optional). It never moves money: the driver confirming the exact fare is what settles the ride. If the amount differs from the fare it is recorded as a cash dispute and audited for staff. Repeating the same amount is fine; a different amount afterwards is refused (409). Cash rides only, after the ride is completed, within 7 days

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/payments - Start paying a completed ride (or a late-cancel / no-show fee) online. The server sets the amount. Same Idempotency-Key, or a payment already under way, returns the same order. Pass checkout.key and checkout.orderId to the Razorpay screen

POST /payments/verify - After the Razorpay screen succeeds, send its orderId, paymentId and signature. Only a valid signature marks the booking paid (PAYMENT_SIGNATURE_INVALID otherwise). The webhook is the backup
GET /payments/{paymentId} - A payment attempt: status CREATED | PAID | FAILED | EXPIRED, amount, refunded amount
GET /customers/me/balance - What the rider owes, per booking, whether each is overdue and payable, and whether new bookings are blocked (UNPAID_BALANCE)
POST /dev/payments/{paymentId}/complete - DEVELOPMENT ONLY (mock payments, never in production): pretend the rider paid, through the same path as a real capture. Not present when real payments are on

POST /webhooks/razorpay - Razorpay calls this (not the apps). Signature checked on the raw body; each event id is processed once. payment.captured / order.paid, payment.failed, refund.processed, refund.failed

header.value: hex hmac of the raw body

item.name: POST /rides/{rideId}/cash-collected - Driver confirms the rider paid the exact fare in cash (CASH bookings only). The cash is added to what the driver holds; too much cash takes them offline until they hand some in
GET /drivers/me/balance - Cash held, what the platform owes the driver, the net (positive = driver owes the platform), the cash limit, and any open settlement
GET /drivers/me/earnings - Per ride: charged, platform commission, and what the driver earned; plus totals for the period
GET /drivers/me/settlements - The driver's own settlements
Health
GET /health/live - Liveness probe
GET /health/ready - Readiness probe (MongoDB, Redis)
Auth
POST /auth/otp/request - Request a login OTP (rate limited per phone and IP)
POST /auth/otp/verify - Verify OTP; creates the account on first login (role CUSTOMER or DRIVER only)

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', d.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', d.refreshToken);

item.name: POST /auth/refresh - Rotate tokens. Reusing an old refresh token revokes the session.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', d.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', d.refreshToken);

item.name: POST /auth/logout - Revoke current session
GET /auth/me - Current user
GET /auth/sessions - List active sessions
DELETE /auth/sessions/{sessionId} - Revoke one of your own sessions
Catalog
GET /cab-categories - List active cab categories
GET /admin/cab-categories - List all categories incl. inactive
POST /admin/cab-categories - Create category
PATCH /admin/cab-categories/{categoryId} - Update category (code is immutable)
Drivers
POST /drivers/applications - Submit (or resubmit) onboarding application
GET /drivers/me/application - Application status, documents, decision reason

POST /drivers/me/documents - Register a KYC document; returns a signed upload URL. Upload the file to that URL with an HTTP PUT whose Content-Type header is exactly the contentType you declared (max 10 MB), then call the "uploaded" endpoint
GET /drivers/me/documents - List own documents

POST /drivers/me/documents/{documentId}/uploaded - Tell the server the file is uploaded. It looks in storage: the file must be there, under 10 MB and of the declared type. A bad file is deleted. Staff can approve a document only when its file is really there
Vehicles
POST /drivers/me/vehicles - Register a vehicle
GET /drivers/me/vehicles - List own vehicles
PATCH /drivers/me/vehicles/{vehicleId} - Edit make/model/color/seats
Zones & Pricing
GET /admin/zones - List service zones
POST /admin/zones - Create a service zone (GeoJSON Polygon, [lng, lat], closed ring)
PATCH /admin/zones/{zoneId} - Update a zone (code immutable; operatingHours null = open 24h)
POST /admin/pricing/configs - Create a NEW fare config version (configs are immutable, no edits)
GET /admin/pricing/configs - List fare config versions
GET /admin/pricing/configs/active - Config currently in force for a zone + category
POST /admin/pricing/cancellation-policies - Create a NEW cancellation / no-show policy version for a zone (append-only). Bookings keep the rules in force when they were made
GET /admin/pricing/cancellation-policies - List cancellation policy versions
POST /admin/pricing/commission - Create a NEW commission rate version for a zone (basis points, 2000 = 20%, at most 5000). Append-only; each booking keeps the rate in force when it was made
GET /admin/pricing/commission - List commission rate versions
Booking
GET /serviceability - Is this pickup/drop inside an open service zone, and which categories are available?

POST /fare-quotes - Server-calculated, expiring (10 min), single-use fare quote. Add scheduledFor (a pickup time between 30 minutes and 7 days from now) to price a ride for later; the zone must be open at that time
GET /fare-quotes/{quoteId} - Read your own quote (status ACTIVE | USED | EXPIRED)
POST /fare-quotes/{quoteId}/refresh - Re-price the same trip as a new quote

POST /bookings - Create a booking from a valid quote. Requires Idempotency-Key; same key + same body returns the same booking (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true). For a ride for later send rideType SCHEDULED and the same scheduledFor as the quote: the booking waits as SCHEDULED, the search for a driver starts about 20 minutes before pickup, and cancelling before then is free. At most 5 waiting at a time.
GET /bookings/{bookingId} - Read a booking (owner customer, or OPS/SUPPORT/SUPER_ADMIN)
GET /bookings/{bookingId}/events - Status timeline (who changed what, when)

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/schedule - Move a ride that is still waiting (SCHEDULED) to another pickup time (same limits as booking; the zone must be open then). 409 RIDE_INVALID_STATE once the search has started
GET /bookings - The rider's own bookings, newest first. With status=SCHEDULED: the rides waiting for later, soonest first. Paged
POST /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/scheduled/cancel - Cancel a ride that is still waiting for its time (SCHEDULED) on the rider's behalf. Free; the rider is told. 409 once the search has started
POST /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/scheduled/start-now - Start the search for a waiting scheduled ride now (for example when the scheduled-rides job was down). Same as the automatic start
Driver presence
POST /drivers/me/presence - Go ONLINE (needs APPROVED driver + VERIFIED vehicle + location) or OFFLINE (blocked during a ride)
GET /drivers/me/presence - Current presence, GPS freshness and eligibility issues
POST /drivers/me/location - GPS heartbeat (throttled; stale, inaccurate or impossible-jump updates are rejected with LOCATION_REJECTED)
Rides
GET /rides/{rideId} - Ride detail, shaped for the caller (customer sees driver card, driver sees rider contact; OTP never included)
POST /rides/{rideId}/en-route - Assigned driver starts heading to pickup (DRIVER_ASSIGNED -> DRIVER_ARRIVING)
POST /rides/{rideId}/arrived - Mark arrival (DRIVER_ARRIVING -> DRIVER_ARRIVED). Judged from the server-held driver location; NOT_AT_PICKUP if too far.
POST /rides/{rideId}/start - Start the ride with the rider's 6-digit pickup OTP (max 5 attempts, expires). Odometer/location are evidence only.
POST /rides/{rideId}/complete - Complete the ride. The server computes the final fare (quoted distance, measured time); payment becomes DUE, never PAID.
POST /rides/{rideId}/cancel - Assigned driver cancels before the ride starts (reason required; no fee yet)
POST /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel - Customer cancels before the ride starts (reason required; no fee yet)
GET /rides/{rideId}/pickup-otp - The rider reads their pickup OTP to the driver (derived, never stored)
POST /rides/{rideId}/otp/resend - Issue a fresh pickup OTP (resets attempts; 30 s cooldown)
GET /rides/{rideId}/track - Driver's last position and ETA, only for the rider on an active ride
GET /customers/me/rides - Customer booking/ride history
GET /drivers/me/rides - Driver ride history

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-preview - What cancelling would cost right now (feePaise, and until when it is free). The same rule the real cancel applies, from the cancellation rules frozen onto the booking

POST /rides/{rideId}/no-show - Driver closes the ride because the rider did not appear. Only after the policy's waiting time at the pickup (NO_SHOW_TOO_EARLY before that) and only at the pickup (NOT_AT_PICKUP). Charges the no-show fee

POST /rides/{rideId}/stops/{index}/arrived - Driver reached intermediate stop number {index} (0 = first). In order, during the trip, within range of the stop (NOT_AT_STOP). Starts the stop waiting clock
POST /rides/{rideId}/stops/{index}/departed - Driver left that stop; the waiting at it ends
POST /rides/{rideId}/destination - Rider asks for a different drop-off. The server prices the new route; the driver has 30 s to answer. Nothing changes until they accept

POST /rides/{rideId}/destination/respond - Driver accepts or declines the pending destination change. Accepting updates the drop-off and the fare estimate (the old fare is kept in the amendment history)
GET /rides/{rideId}/receipt - Receipt for a completed ride (or a ride that ended with a cancellation / no-show fee): fixed receipt number, itemised fare, waiting, fees, payment status
Finance
GET /admin/payments - Search payment attempts by status or booking

POST /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/refund - Refund (part of) a payment. destination ORIGINAL (default) sends it back through Razorpay and completes when the refund webhook arrives; WALLET credits the rider’s wallet at once (the only choice for a ride paid from the wallet). Needs an Idempotency-Key. Never more than was paid in total. The platform bears the cost; the driver keeps their share
POST /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/write-off - Give up on money a rider will not pay (SUPER_ADMIN only). The driver is still paid; the platform takes the loss
PATCH /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/payment-dispute - Open or close a payment dispute on an unpaid booking (a disputed booking does not block the rider)
GET /admin/ledger - The append-only ledger: transactions with their entries, filterable by account, booking, driver or kind
GET /admin/balances/drivers - Every driver's cash held, earnings owed and net, worst first; filter to those over the cash limit

GET /admin/finance/consistency - Do the books balance? Ledger total, unbalanced transactions, rides not yet recorded, payments not yet recorded, and the gateway balance against captured minus refunded
POST /admin/drivers/{driverId}/cash-deposits - Record that a driver handed cash over. Needs an Idempotency-Key; cannot exceed the cash they hold
POST /admin/settlements - Draft a settlement for one driver ({ driverId }) or everyone with a balance ({ all: true }): earnings netted against cash held, leaving a payout or a deposit still due
GET /admin/settlements - List settlements
GET /admin/settlements/{settlementId} - One settlement
POST /admin/settlements/{settlementId}/approve - Approve a draft: nets the driver's cash against their earnings in the ledger. Refused if the balances have changed since the draft
POST /admin/settlements/{settlementId}/mark-paid - Record that the payout was sent (bank transfer made outside the system), with its reference
POST /admin/settlements/{settlementId}/cancel - Cancel a draft settlement (an approved one cannot be cancelled)
Config
GET /config/flags - Which features are on for the caller's role (SOS, trip sharing, support tickets, ratings, coupons). Apps read this at start-up and hide what is off
GET /admin/feature-flags - Every feature switch with its current value and whether staff or the default set it
PUT /admin/feature-flags/{key} - Switch a feature on or off, optionally only for some roles. Keys: SOS, TRIP_SHARING, SUPPORT_TICKETS, RATINGS, COUPONS. Audited
Staff
GET /admin/staff - List staff accounts

POST /admin/staff - Create a staff account by phone number and role. With an email the person gets a setup link (password + authenticator); without one they sign in with a phone code, which is refused in production

PATCH /admin/staff/{userId}/role - Change a staff member's role (never your own). Their sessions are ended so the new role applies at once. Suspend or reactivate staff with PATCH /admin/users/{id}/status
POST /admin/staff/{userId}/credentials - Give a staff member an email login, or reset a lost password / authenticator: emails a new setup link and ends their old logins. Super admin only
Safety

POST /rides/{rideId}/sos - Raise an emergency alert during a live ride (rider or the assigned driver). The ride carries on; staff are alerted at once and the person's saved contacts are texted. Repeating it returns the same alert. Needs the SOS feature on
GET /rides/{rideId}/sos - Your own alerts on this ride and their status
GET /me/emergency-contacts - Your saved emergency contacts (at most 3)
POST /me/emergency-contacts - Save an emergency contact
DELETE /me/emergency-contacts/{contactId} - Remove a saved contact
POST /rides/{rideId}/share - Rider creates a link so others can follow the live trip. Returns the token; the link works only while the ride is live and can be stopped
DELETE /rides/{rideId}/share - Stop sharing: every link for this ride stops working
GET /public/trips/{token} - What someone holding a trip-share link sees: driver first name, vehicle, live position, no phone numbers. Nothing once the ride ends. No login; rate limited
Safety desk
GET /admin/incidents - Emergency alerts, newest first
GET /admin/incidents/{incidentId} - One alert with the rider and driver contact details and the ride snapshot. Viewing is audited
GET /admin/incidents/{incidentId}/location - Where the driver is right now (poll while an alert is open)
POST /admin/incidents/{incidentId}/acknowledge - Take an alert. Alerts nobody takes within 2 minutes are escalated to a super admin
POST /admin/incidents/{incidentId}/notes - Add a note to an alert
POST /admin/incidents/{incidentId}/resolve - Close an alert with its outcome: FALSE_ALARM | ASSISTED | POLICE_INFORMED | OTHER
Support

POST /support/tickets - Raise a help request, optionally about one of your rides (category FARE_DISPUTE, PAYMENT_ISSUE, DRIVER_BEHAVIOUR, RIDER_BEHAVIOUR, LOST_ITEM, SAFETY_CONCERN, APP_PROBLEM, OTHER). A safety concern is high priority
GET /support/tickets - Your tickets, most recently active first
GET /support/tickets/{ticketId} - A ticket with its conversation (staff-only notes are never shown)
POST /support/tickets/{ticketId}/messages - Reply on your ticket (a resolved ticket reopens)
POST /support/tickets/{ticketId}/close - Close your ticket
Support desk
GET /admin/support/tickets - The queue: filter by status, category, priority, assignee, unassigned or a search; overdue = no reply after 24 hours
GET /admin/support/tickets/{ticketId} - A ticket with the whole conversation including internal notes
POST /admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/assign - Assign to a staff member (default: yourself)
POST /admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/messages - Reply to the user, or add an internal note ({ internal: true })
PATCH /admin/support/tickets/{ticketId} - Change status (IN_PROGRESS | WAITING_USER) or priority

POST /admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/resolve - Resolve with an outcome (REFUNDED | FEE_WAIVED | WARNING_ISSUED | NO_ACTION | ESCALATED | OTHER) and a note the user sees. The refund / fee waiver itself is done with the finance endpoints
Ratings
POST /rides/{rideId}/rating - Rate the other person 1-5 once the ride is completed (within 7 days; once per ride per side). Tags depend on who is rating
GET /rides/{rideId}/rating - Whether you have rated this ride, your rating, whether you still can, and the tags you may use
GET /drivers/me/ratings - Your average, how many ratings, the spread, and your recent ratings (riders are never named)
GET /admin/ratings - Low ratings for review (default 2 stars or fewer)
PATCH /admin/ratings/{ratingId} - Hide (or unhide) an abusive comment; the stars still count
Reports

GET /admin/reports/summary - Operations numbers for a period (default last 7 days, at most 92): bookings by status, completion/cancel/no-driver rates, fares, discounts, commission, time to find a driver, offer acceptance, active drivers, a per-day series (India time)

GET /admin/exports/{kind} - Download a CSV (kind: rides, payments, settlements, ledger; add .csv). Rides are for OPS, FINANCE and SUPER_ADMIN; payments, settlements and the ledger for FINANCE and SUPER_ADMIN. At most 50,000 rows; ids only, no phone numbers; every download is audited
Coupons

POST /admin/coupons - Create a promotion code: PERCENT (value in basis points, 1000 = 10%) or FLAT (paise), optional cap, minimum fare, dates, total and per-rider limits, zones, cab types. The platform pays for the discount; the driver is paid on the full fare
GET /admin/coupons - List coupons with how many times each has been used
PATCH /admin/coupons/{couponId} - Switch a coupon off, extend its end date, or raise its limit (never below what was used)
Tips

POST /rides/{rideId}/tip - Rider tips the driver after a completed ride (within 24 hours, Rs 10 to Rs 2,000, one tip per ride). source ONLINE returns a checkout to pay through Razorpay; WALLET pays at once from the wallet balance. The driver receives all of it (no commission). Needs an Idempotency-Key. Needs the TIPS feature on
GET /rides/{rideId}/tip - The tip on this ride, or { tip: null }. The rider also gets the payment details to finish paying; the driver sees it once it is paid
Wallet
GET /wallet - The rider’s wallet: balance, the limits, and the latest entries (money in positive, money out negative). Needs the WALLET feature on for changes, not for looking

POST /wallet/topups - Add money: starts an online payment (Rs 50 to Rs 5,000 each; the wallet holds at most Rs 10,000). Finish it with the usual checkout and /payments/verify; the wallet is credited when the payment is confirmed. Needs an Idempotency-Key
POST /bookings/{bookingId}/pay-from-wallet - Pay what a booking owes (fare or fee) from the wallet balance, at once. 402 INSUFFICIENT_WALLET_BALANCE if there is not enough. Needs an Idempotency-Key
GET /admin/wallets/{customerId} - A rider’s wallet balance and latest entries, for support and finance
Payouts

GET /drivers/me/payout-account - Where the driver’s earnings are sent: type, holder name, hidden number, and review status (PENDING until finance checks it, then ACTIVE or REJECTED), or { account: null }

PUT /drivers/me/payout-account - Save (or replace) the bank account or UPI id for payouts. The full number goes to the payout service only; we keep the last 4 digits. A new or changed account is PENDING until finance verifies it
GET /admin/drivers/{driverId}/payout-account - A driver’s payout account (numbers hidden) and its review status

POST /admin/drivers/{driverId}/payout-account/review - Approve or reject a new or changed payout account (confirm the holder name matches the driver first). No money is sent to an account that is not ACTIVE

POST /admin/settlements/{settlementId}/payout - Send an APPROVED settlement’s payout to the driver’s verified account through the payout service. Safe to repeat: a payout already on its way is returned, never sent twice. The settlement becomes PAID when the service confirms (webhook). Not used if AUTO_PAYOUTS is on
GET /admin/settlements/{settlementId}/payouts - Every payout attempt for a settlement (status CREATED | PROCESSING | PAID | FAILED | REVERSED, bank reference, failure reason)
GET /admin/payouts - Payout attempts, newest first, filtered by status or driver
POST /dev/payouts/{payoutId}/complete - DEVELOPMENT ONLY (mock payouts): pretend the bank confirmed the transfer. Not available when real payouts are on

POST /webhooks/razorpayx - The payout service (RazorpayX) calls this, not the apps. Signature checked on the raw body; each event id is processed once. payout.processed, payout.failed / rejected, payout.reversed

header.value: hex hmac of the raw body

item.name: Analytics
GET /admin/analytics/demand - When people ask for rides: a Monday-to-Sunday by hour (India time) grid of requests and completed rides, plus the split by zone. Period default last 28 days, at most 92
GET /admin/analytics/fulfilment - How well demand is served, hour by hour (India time): requests, completed, no driver found, cancelled, rates, and average seconds to find a driver
GET /admin/analytics/cancellations - Why rides are lost: share by who cancelled, by reason (with how many minutes after the request), and the cancellation / no-show fees due or waived
GET /admin/analytics/drivers - Drivers ranked by completed rides: earnings, tips, how often they accept offers, rating. Staff only
GET /admin/analytics/retention - Active riders and drivers in the last 24 hours / 7 / 30 days, and weekly groups of new riders with the share who rode again in each following week
GET /admin/analytics/revenue - Money by day (India time): fares, discounts, commission, driver earnings, tips, refunds, and what was collected by method (card or wallet) and purpose
Corporate
GET /corporate/me - Your company account: the company, your limits and what you have used this month, and any invitations waiting for you (matched by your phone number)
POST /corporate/invitations/{membershipId}/accept - Accept an invitation to a company account. You can be in one company at a time
POST /corporate/me/leave - Leave your company account (the only admin cannot leave)
GET /corporate/employees - Company admin: the company's people with their monthly limit and what each has used this month
POST /corporate/employees - Company admin: invite an employee by phone number (they accept in the app). Optional own monthly limit and role
PATCH /corporate/employees/{membershipId} - Company admin: change an employee's monthly limit or role, or remove them. You cannot remove or demote yourself
GET /corporate/rides - Company admin: every ride billed to the company, newest first, with the rider, route, company reference and whether it is invoiced
GET /corporate/invoices - Company admin: the company's issued and paid invoices
GET /corporate/invoices/{invoiceId} - Company admin: one invoice with all its lines
POST /admin/corporate - Create a company account with its first admin (invited by phone). Defaults: credit limit Rs 50,000, payment terms 15 days, Rs 10,000 per employee per month
GET /admin/corporate - Company accounts, by name
GET /admin/corporate/{companyId} - One company with its admins, how much it owes, rides not yet billed, credit still available and invoiced-unpaid
PATCH /admin/corporate/{companyId} - Change a company's limits, terms or status (SUSPENDED stops new rides on the account at once)
POST /admin/corporate/{companyId}/invoices - Gather the company's billed rides and fees accrued in a period into a DRAFT invoice. Each ride is on one invoice only. Tax is not calculated by the system
GET /admin/corporate-invoices - Invoices across companies, newest first; overdue=true for issued invoices past their due date
GET /admin/corporate-invoices/{invoiceId} - One invoice with its lines and payments
POST /admin/corporate-invoices/{invoiceId}/issue - Issue a draft: gives it its number (CI-year-sequence) and a due date from the company's terms
POST /admin/corporate-invoices/{invoiceId}/void - Cancel a draft or an unpaid issued invoice; its rides can go on a new invoice
POST /admin/corporate-invoices/{invoiceId}/payments - Record a bank payment from the company (part or all). Needs an Idempotency-Key; a repeat returns the same result. Never more than is left to pay
POST /admin/corporate-bookings/{bookingId}/credit - Take (part of) a company ride's charge off what the company owes, before it is invoiced. The platform bears the cost; the driver keeps their share
Staff login

POST /auth/staff/setup - Step 1 of a new staff account (from the emailed link, valid 3 days, single use): choose a password (12+ characters, not common, not your name or email). Returns the authenticator secret to scan and a short-lived setupSession

POST /auth/staff/setup/confirm - Step 2: enter the first 6-digit code from the authenticator app. Turns two-step sign-in on, signs the person in, and returns 8 one-time recovery codes (shown only now)

POST /auth/staff/login - Staff sign-in step 1: email and password. Answers { mfaRequired, mfaToken } (valid 5 minutes). Wrong details always give the same answer; 5 wrong attempts lock the account for 15 minutes
POST /auth/staff/mfa - Staff sign-in step 2: the 6-digit authenticator code (each code works once) or a recovery code. Returns the session tokens. Staff sessions last 12 hours
POST /auth/staff/password/forgot - Email a reset link (valid 1 hour). Always answers the same, so nobody can find out who has an account
POST /auth/staff/password/reset - Choose a new password with the emailed link AND a code from the authenticator (or a recovery code). Signs out every old login
POST /auth/staff/password/change - Change your own password (needs the current password and a fresh authenticator code). Your other logins end; this one stays
Privacy

GET /me/data-export - A copy of your data as JSON: account, bookings, payments, wallet, tips, ratings you gave, support tickets, emergency contacts, devices, and (drivers) vehicles and document status. Once every 5 minutes. Money records are kept by law even after deletion

GET /me/deletion - Whether you have asked to delete your account, when it will happen, and anything that must be sorted out first (an unfinished ride, an unpaid amount, wallet money, a driver settlement)

POST /me/deletion - Ask to delete your account. It happens after 7 days (cancel any time before); refused while something is unresolved. Your name and phone are removed and the phone number can be used again; money records stay, anonymised
DELETE /me/deletion - Cancel a deletion request while it is waiting
POST /admin/users/{userId}/delete - Delete an account now (for example a legal request), under the same conditions. Recorded in the audit log
Trips
POST /admin/rental-packages - Create an hourly rental package for a zone and cab type
GET /admin/rental-packages - List rental packages
PATCH /admin/rental-packages/{packageId} - Change a package price or switch it off (hours and km cannot change: make a new package)
POST /admin/outstation-rates - Set outstation rates for a zone and cab type
GET /admin/outstation-rates - List outstation rates
PATCH /admin/outstation-rates/{rateId} - Change outstation rates or switch them off
GET /rental-packages - Rental packages available at a location (then quote with rentalPackageId)
GET /outstation/options - Cab types and per-km rates for outstation trips from a location (then quote with outstation)
GET /drivers/me/preferences - Which long trips the driver accepts (rentals, outstation)
PATCH /drivers/me/preferences - Choose whether to be offered rentals and outstation trips
